keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Robert Renan (Vasco da Gama) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chapecoense 0, Vasco da Gama 1. Bruno Duarte (Vasco da Gama) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Andrés Gómez with a cross.
First Half ends, Chapecoense 0, Vasco da Gama 1.
Substitution, Chapecoense. David replaces Yago Felipe.
Second Half begins Chapecoense 0, Vasco da Gama 1.
Dylan Borrero (Chapecoense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chapecoense. Fernando replaces Dylan Borrero.
Delay in match because of an injury Robert Renan (Vasco da Gama).
Delay in match (Chapecoense).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Lucas Freitas replaces Robert Renan because of an injury.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Ramon Rique replaces Marino Hinestroza.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Loide Augusto replaces Facundo Colidio.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Cuiabano replaces Lucas Piton.
Substitution, Chapecoense. Rodrigo Endrio replaces Max.
Camilo (Chapecoense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chapecoense 0, Vasco da Gama 2. Bruno Duarte (Vasco da Gama) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Loide Augusto.
Substitution, Vasco da Gama. Brenner replaces Bruno Duarte.
Bruno Pacheco (Chapecoense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chapecoense. Miguel Carvalho replaces Giovanni Augusto.
